acceptance_predicates.description: The ASB and TUI state repositories contain matching AR-1665 task, plan, and spec records.
The scoped historical metadata validates through the supported task-spec and evidence vocabulary without changing product behavior.
AR-1658 through AR-1664 intent, evidence identity, and development-only nonblocking rules are preserved.
Schema, dependency graph, generated views, signatures, and DCO checks pass from fresh checkouts.

definition_of_done: Paired metadata is committed with signed DCO-bearing commits.
Independent validation records exact heads and any residual legacy records outside the scoped repair.

inputs.description: Exact ASB and TUI coordination state heads and scoped historical task metadata.

outputs.description: Signed paired metadata repair and validation receipt.

gates.description: Only task, plan, and spec metadata changes are present and supported validation passes.
